text_block_list.text:
With Christmas just around the corner,
I invited Cheval Grand out to reward her for all her hard work, and...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? B-But I feel bad...
Spending time with someone like me—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-If you'd like, Trainer, by all means...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
U-Um!
There's somewhere I'd like to go...
Would it be okay if we went there...?

"To be honest, I was a little surprised.
I was sure she'd hold back out of hesitation, so for her to state her wish like that..."

—And on the day of our outing,
even though I arrived a bit early,
she was already there waiting...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! You're early today.
choice_data_list: You deserve it more than anyone, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
No, I just wanted to arrive early...
To check the route, and stuff...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... The illumination here is amazing every year. Maybe because it's near the sea, it's pretty warm even in winter.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"That's the kind of thing. There's plenty more too...
Street stalls, live street performances,
so many interesting things..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'll guide the way!

And while browsing the various booths,
we strolled leisurely, taking in the illumination lights.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...How... is it...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —And from right here, the night view is...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"This is also so pretty, so
I really wanted to show it to you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
............
Are you... having fun...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness.

"She seems a little different from usual today.
Is she just excited because she's in a place she likes? No..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Next is over here!
The view from the stairs is a pretty great hidden spot, too.
It's not crowded, and it's easy to see...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry we're only visiting places I like, bu—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"No... That's not it...!
I also recommend this one...!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Even though I swore
I wouldn't say things like this today...
choice_data_list: What do you mean, something like this...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
Um... I was thinking.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Holding back or being too humble...
I wonder if that's really the right way to go...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking... maybe deep down, you're just protecting yourself
because you're afraid of being rejected...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Trainer is... so kind, and yet.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
We've been together for three whole years,
so if I keep staying scared, um...
doesn't it seem like I don't trust you...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
So... I just really wanted to make sure
you knew that wasn't the case...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: This is...! It's nothing spec... no, wait!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I picked it out thinking you'd definitely love it!
Merry Christmas!!"

"She spoke with complete honesty.
Back when we first met, she never would have said something like this."

Yet her hands were trembling.
Her sheer desperation was painfully clear.
And so, without thinking, I...
(Clench—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...!? Ah, your hand...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I'm...
shivering... this much...
I instinctively took hold of her hand, and before long, the trembling in her cold fingers subsided, and color returned to her skin.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Uuu... How pathetic...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry...
It seems I can't just change that quickly.
choice_data_list: Taking it one step at a time is fine, isn't it?
Taking it bit by bit is totally fine, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Yes!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yes... Please allow me to express my gratitude as well.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Your hands were so warm, Trainer.

Inside the present was a pair of gloves.
I put them on right away and headed down from the observation deck.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
What should we do... next?
It's about time for dinner, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huuuh~! If it isn't Cheval-chi♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
My, was this the place you were going out with your Trainer?
Fufu, what a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: B-Both of you...?!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thank you as always for looking after my sister.
Oh? Trainer, those gloves you have...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: That's the thing Cheval-chi showed me on that online shop the other day!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: She kept aaalways asking me things like "How's this?" and "Is this stylish?"...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Is that what it is?!
It wasn't that Cheval wanted it~.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I thought something was up.
It really was a present
for the Trainer after all, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: W-Wait...! Stop it!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
B-But...
Uuuu...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Let's go! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah! You're blushing~! Wait uuuup!

"Cheval ran away from the scene.
Somehow, her sisters caught up with her, and the four of them headed back to the academy together in high spirits."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Is there anything you'd like to eat?
choice_data_list: In that case, I know the perfect place!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Eeeek...!

Actually, I looked up a few restaurants and cafes where we could get in without reservations,
just so we have flexibility depending on where we go.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Incredible... Every single item on the wall menu looks so delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Which one should I choose?
Oh, look at all these Christmas cakes too...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: The strawberry one... and the Bûche de Noël too... They both look so good...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"No... That's a bit too much...!
Wouldn't that be leaning on you way too heavily...?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
P-Please don't make that face...!
It's not that I'm holding back, it's just... um...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
See, I tend to gain weight easily,
so I really have to watch my weight management...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Still, um...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Truth is... I want to eat cake together with you... It's Christmas, after all...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"So, why don't we split them in half?
That way, we can both taste each one..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
I kind of thought
you might say that...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Once again,
Merry Christmas...
